canonical_statement: Choice between rituximab and cyclophosphamide for induction should account for age, fertility concerns, frailty, glucocorticoid-sparing needs, relapse history, PR3-ANCA status, access to rituximab, and severe glomerulonephritis.

canonical_statement: Consider discontinuing immunosuppressive therapy after 3 months in patients who remain on dialysis and have no extrarenal manifestations of disease.
